africa.text: The Central African Republic and the Democratic Republic of Congo have launched a joint operation to curb Ebola’s spread in border regions.
A 12‑storey residential building under construction collapsed in Nairobi, killing dozens and prompting emergency rescue efforts.
Health officials confirmed the first human case of the newly identified "Shamonda" virus in a patient from western Kenya.

oceania.text: Australia partners with biotech firms to develop the world’s first mRNA vaccine targeting melanoma.
Critics suggest repurposing Powerhouse Parramatta’s budget for broader public transport upgrades.
Homeowners face doubled costs due to rising construction fees; experts urge streamlined regulations to lower prices.
Sydney imposes nightly caps and voluntary levies to curb short‑term rental growth.

north-america.text: The U.S. will cut tariffs by half on nine Canadian product categories, announced by a Maine senator, aiming to boost cross‑border trade.
Meta faces a record $25 billion fine, illustrating regulators’ new approach to penalizing major tech firms.
Alberta’s referendum result does not guarantee Western satisfaction, warns former Reform leader Preston Manning, calling the assumption a “huge mistake.”
Canada’s Liberals will introduce a bill on Tuesday banning medical aid in dying for mental illness alone.
